## Teaching points

1. A zone-two fifth metatarsal fracture has a higher risk of delayed union than a tuberosity avulsion.
2. Locate the fracture relative to the fifth metatarsal tuberosity; a Jones fracture is not interchangeable with a simple avulsion.
3. Protect the fracture from loading while arranging early orthopedic advice; athlete preferences may influence definitive treatment.
4. Return for new numbness, a tight splint or worsening swelling. Healing is measured in weeks, not an ED shift.
